def sprites(g):
    from collections import defaultdict
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v: cells[v].append((r,c))
    out={}
    for v,pts in cells.items():
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
        h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cs)-c0+1
        m=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for r,c in pts: m[r-r0][c-c0]=v
        out[v]=m
    return out
def transform(g):
    sp=sprites(g)
    hs=[len(m) for m in sp.values()]
    H=max(hs)
    cols=[]
    for v in sorted(sp):
        m=sp[v]
        for c in zip(*m):
            cols.append(list(c)+[0]*(H-len(c)))
    return [list(row) for row in zip(*cols)]
